## Scope

Describe the bounded change and any interface decisions.

## Evidence

- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Core tests pass with exact counts recorded
- [ ] Generated artifacts trace to result manifests
- [ ] Optional products are tested or explicitly skipped
- [ ] Claims, provenance, and third-party notices are accurate
- [ ] No credentials, license files, caches, or proprietary data are included

## Scientific impact

List any changed equations, units, assumptions, parameters, metrics, or acceptance tolerances. Explain why a changed tolerance is scientifically justified.
